title: Add the custom quests on the quests page
body:
## What is wrong or wanted

No custom quest exists. Traders do not offer work. A scene reward is not created. Papyrus quests do not run, so the offer, the check, and the turn-in have to be the server's.

The plan is `docs/systems/quests.md`. Use that page's counts, cooldowns, and lineup. Do not invent a second list.

## Where it lives

`docs/systems/quests.md`
`docs/systems/gold.md`
`game/gamemode.js`

## Steps

- [ ] Supply: the item is one the hold's submitted lists already buy. Count 5. Cooldown 6 hours. Pay that hold's buy price out of the trader's purse. If the purse cannot cover 5, offer nothing.
- [ ] Scarce: the table on the quests page. The place holds more than the ask. Turn in the ask and keep the extra. Walking away puts the goods back and does not start the cooldown. Rank still applies.
- [ ] Scene: the locked lineup on the quests page, retrievals and the kill contracts written there. Gold is created when the quest is finished. A retrieval is one quest item, put back if you walk away, taken on turn-in.
- [ ] The rare mine the scarce rows use is the single place from the miner work. Do not leave the extra veins open.

## Done when

Each quest on that page can be taken, the server checks the deed, and the gold and the cooldown match the page.

## Traps

Dragon is not a bounty. Scene gold is created. It is not taken from the trader's 250. Supply gold is taken from that purse. Do not add a quest that buys food, ore, or a crafted good. Do not add quests past the locked lineup. Letters are the notice board, not this list.

Order: 810

title: Add notice-board letters and the Raven Rock board
body:
## What is wrong or wanted

Fees, reach, unpin, take, dropjob, and the steward board commands are in the server. Letters are not. `/letter` and `/deliver` do not exist. A courier is not paid. Nine boards are seeded. Raven Rock is not among them. Solitude's spot was corrected from a walked coordinate and still wants somebody to stand on it. Half fees for the guild are not in the posting fee.

## Where it lives

`docs/systems/noticeboards.md`
`game/gamemode.js`

## Steps

- [ ] Add `/letter` and `/deliver` as written on the notice boards page. The sender pays. The courier cannot read the letter. Unpin before delivery returns the courier's pay and keeps the board fee.
- [ ] Seed Raven Rock's board at that town's inn until a steward walks it.
- [ ] Keep a steward's walked spot. A later seeding must not put it back.
- [ ] Once guild dues exist, a member whose dues are clear pays the half fee. Until then the full fee stays.

## Done when

A person can post a sealed letter, hand it to the named person within the distance on the page, and the gold matches the page. Ten boards exist, one per town.

## Traps

The courier pay is the sender's gold. It is not created. There is no courier cooldown. Do not build the optional body meter.

Order: 811

title: Add the Merchant's Guild roll, dues, ledgers, and trader purses
body:
## What is wrong or wanted

The hold's box is in the server and takes gold. It does not take a price list. There is no roll, no join fee of 50, no dues of 10 per in-game week, no factor, and no half-fee. Posting is 20 and 30 for everybody. Rent is the only debt the box pays down. A guild trader's 250 is not handed out. Traders do not buy and sell from a purse the server tracks.

## Where it lives

`docs/systems/merchants-guild.md`
`docs/systems/gold.md`
`docs/systems/npcs.md`
`game/gamemode.js`

## Steps

- [ ] Join costs 50. Dues are 10 per in-game week. Half the notice fee and half the job fee only while dues are clear.
- [ ] A submitted ledger in the hold's drop box sets that hold's buy and sell average for each item. If a hold has no list, use the average of the holds that submitted one. If no ledger anywhere names the item, the trader neither buys nor sells it.
- [ ] Hand each guild trader 250 once, then change that purse only when they buy or sell. An empty purse does not pay. An empty shelf does not sell. Stock is what they have bought.
- [ ] The factor is the office the page names. Do not invent a second price list for supply quests.

## Done when

A hold with a submitted list has those prices, a trader's purse moves when they trade, and a member with clear dues pays half the posting fees.

## Traps

Scene-quest gold is created and is not this purse. The starting purse of a person is 40, once, and that part is already in the server. An item has no gold price of its own.

Order: 812

body:

Personal journals, J, and sharing a page with a friend are in the server. The group tab is not. There is no price list, no group role, and no group chat. The server does not store the time a character last left. Nothing submits a price list to a hold's drop box. Business Owner and Faction Owner are not Discord roles the staff list reads.

`docs/systems/factions.md`
`docs/systems/journal.md`
`game/gamemode.js`

- [ ] Submitting the list at the hold's drop box is what the guild averages read.
- [ ] Store the time a character last left, the way the page says.
- [ ] Read Business Owner and Faction Owner off the Discord account the same way the other staff seats are read.

## Done when

A business or a faction can keep its list, its roles, and its chat, and a submitted list is the ledger the guild box accepts.

## Traps

A personal journal is not a quest and is already in the server. Do not replace it. The price list is not a gold column on the recipe book.

Order: 813

title: Roll the sky by season and stop crops in winter
body:
## What is wrong or wanted

Place, weather numbers, fire, water, clothing, and `/needs` are in the server. A season is not. The sky is not rolled. Crops do not read the season. A beehive is not a farmer verb. The plan is `docs/systems/temperature.md` and `docs/systems/classes/farmer.md`.

## Where it lives

`docs/systems/temperature.md`
`docs/systems/classes/farmer.md`
`game/gamemode.js`
`game/data/weather.json`

## Steps

- [ ] Four seasons, 7 real days each, province-wide, starting in spring. Spring and summer: all crops. Autumn: novice and advanced, expert waits. Winter: no growth, the plot stays sown, the crop clock pauses, even on a warm day.
- [ ] One sky roll per climate, shared, lasting 20 to 60 real minutes, using the odds on the temperature page. Snowy and mild climates shift those odds the way that page says. The next sky is not announced.
- [ ] Use the Cathedral records already in `weather.json`. Do not add a season mod that follows the game's months or that bans rain in winter.
- [ ] A placed hive is a farmer verb: 1 honeycomb, 10 minutes, one work piece, novice, no rank gate.

## Done when

The outdoor target shifts by the season on the page, the sky can be clear in winter and snow in summer, and a winter plot does not grow. A farmer can work a hive.

## Traps

Winter changes the odds. It does not lock the sky to snow. Indoors ignore the season shift. Falling snow is still the extra cold. Standing in snow on the ground is the snow place target, not a clear sky. The cold link into hunger and thirst is the needs work, not this one.

Order: 814

title: Make gathering shared, ranked, and closed to other work
body:
## What is wrong or wanted

The gather verb, the ranks, the ten minutes, and the list are in the server. The wait is still per person, so someone else can take the same plant while you wait. A press from someone who is not a gatherer is not refused before the plant is consumed. World records filed with no rank do not yet use the ranks on the gatherer page.

## Where it lives

`docs/systems/classes/gatherer.md`
`docs/systems/lists/unranked.md`
`game/gamemode.js`

## Steps

- [ ] One wait for a plant, shared. The next person cannot take it early.
- [ ] Refuse a press from someone who is not a gatherer before the plant is consumed.
- [ ] Apply the ranks written under "What you cannot do" on the gatherer page. A produce already on the ladder keeps that rank. Cabbage, carrot, gourds, leek, potato, and wheat stay the farmer's. A clam and a fish stay the fisher's. A coin purse and an estate key are not a harvest. Mammoth cheese and a mead barrel stay off every ladder.

## Done when

Two people cannot harvest the same plant on two clocks, a non-gatherer does not consume it, and the formerly unranked records carry the ranks on the page.

## Traps

Do not put the beehive, the nest, or the churn on the gatherer. Those are farmer verbs. Do not add a gold price.

Order: 815

title: Place the fishery, require a pole, and add the trap
body:
## What is wrong or wanted

The old fifteen fish records are in the server. No pole is required. The fishing mod's rods are in the collection and do nothing. None of the new water is placed. The trap is not a recipe. A fisher is not handed a pole. The plan is `docs/systems/classes/fisher.md` and the pole ingredients on that page.

## Where it lives

`docs/systems/classes/fisher.md`
`docs/systems/creation.md`
`game/gamemode.js`

- [ ] Place the water counts, waits, and yields written on the fisher page, including the Abecean longfin and the Solstheim spots.
- [ ] Add the trap recipe from that page. Up to 3 traps.
- [ ] The pole recipes are the ones on the fisher page. They do not use dragon bone. The fishing-mod rod rows are not the plan.

## Done when

A fisher without a pole catches nothing, the new water matches the page, and the trap can be made from the ingredients written there.

## Traps

Tool uses are 50 in the tool work, including the pole. Dragon bone stays cut. Do not keep the fishing-mod ingredient list.

Order: 816

title: Make each rare mine one place and use the plan's seam times
body:
## What is wrong or wanted

The server still has 581 veins, a deposit of 20, and yields that climb past the plan. Heart stone is forced to advanced. Iron, gold, corundum, and silver all come back in 10 minutes. Ebony is 6 veins, the gems are 3 each, stalhrim is 2, heart stone is 4. There is no single place, and a steward does not guard it.

## Where it lives

`docs/systems/classes/miner.md`
`docs/systems/quests.md`
`game/gamemode.js`

- [ ] Use the waits, yields, and deposit written on the miner page. The table under "Every record" is the server book. The numbers above it are the plan.
- [ ] Ebony, the gems, stalhrim, and heart stone are one place each. The scarce quest is what opens that place.
- [ ] Heart stone's plan rank is master. The ore file still says advanced. Change the rank the server enforces to master.

A rare seam is one place, shut until the scarce quest opens it, and the common seams come back on the plan's clock.

## Traps

The pick's 50 uses are the tool work. Do not leave the extra rare veins in the world. A steward guards the place the way the miner page says, and does not become the quest giver. The trader gives the quest.

body:

The tools in the server have 100 uses. The plan is 50. That is the pick, the shovel, the axe, the pole, and the tool handed at creation.

title: Apply the meal, drink, wet, and cold rules
body:
## What is wrong or wanted

Hunger, thirst, and the ale curve are partly in the server. Raw, burnt, cooked, and feast are not. Every meal is 15 until those states exist. Eating does not take 8 seconds. A full stomach does not sicken you. Soup does not add thirst. Cold does not speed hunger or thirst. Water is not tagged by where it was filled. Every non-ale drink is 20. The ale damage help, the sway, and the hangover are not in. Wet does not last 3 minutes. A meal does not warm. Tea and skooma are not items the needs block knows. Potion heal does not fall off across a short window.

The optional body meter is not this work.

## Where it lives

`docs/systems/food.md`
`docs/systems/drink.md`
`docs/systems/hunger.md`
`docs/systems/thirst.md`
`docs/systems/temperature.md`
`docs/systems/exhaustion.md`
`docs/systems/potions.md`
`game/gamemode.js`

## Steps

- [ ] Meals use the raw, burnt, cooked, and feast numbers on the food page, including the 8 seconds, the one cooked help, the feast, and the full-stomach rule.
- [ ] Tag water by source and use the fouled chances on the disease page when disease exists. Until that disease exists, still tag the source.
- [ ] Ale uses the sway, the damage help, and the hangover on the drink page.
- [ ] Cold multiplies hunger and thirst the way those pages say. Wet lasts 3 real minutes. A roof does not dry you the moment the client says you are under one, beyond what the temperature page allows.
- [ ] Tea and skooma do what the exhaustion page says. A second dose refreshes the clock and adds the crash again.
- [ ] Potions use the sip, the windows, and the falling heal on the potions page.

## Done when

A cooked meal, a ditch drink, a third ale, a snow hunger clock, and a second potion in the window each match the page that names them.

## Traps

Do not build the body meter, an outhouse, or a pot. `/rest bed` finding a real bed is the property work. Food sickness itself is the injury and disease work. This work only has to start that sickness where the food page says a full stomach or raw meat does.

Order: 819

title: Add injury, the downed state, and disease
body:
## What is wrong or wanted

Health reaching zero is the engine's death. The wake is in the server. There is no downed state and no wound record. Fire still hurts and is not yet a burn afterwards. Disease is not in the server. Cure disease potions count only as a sip of thirst. Nothing in the needs block reads a disease. Open-ground sleep is not a chill.

## Where it lives

`docs/systems/injury.md`
`docs/systems/disease.md`
`docs/systems/death.md`
`docs/systems/exhaustion.md`
`game/gamemode.js`

## Steps

- [ ] Cuts, breaks, burns, bites, and the downed clock use the numbers on the injury page, including the splint, the crooked heal, and the missing eye.
- [ ] Chill, food sickness, fouled water, wound fever, and bite sickness use the chances and the clocks on the disease page.
- [ ] An hour of sleep on open ground can start a chill. A cure in the caught window clears it.
- [ ] A cure disease potion cures. It is not only a sip.

## Done when

A person can go down, be stabilized, carry a wound, catch each disease on the page, and clear it the way the page says.

## Traps

The optional body meter is not in this. Food sickness does not fill that meter. Vampirism and lycanthropy stay with death, not this list. There is no crime gold. Agreed lasting harm on the site stays a record on the character only where the injury page says the wound lasts.

Order: 820

title: Track condition, repair kits, and the dull clock
body:
## What is wrong or wanted

Nothing tracks a condition on a piece, and no kit exists as a recipe. The grindstone and the armour table still appear in the crafting menu. A temper does not reach the server, so it is not refused and it is not counted as work. Nothing loses 5% a day for sitting in a chest.

## Where it lives

`docs/systems/durability.md`
`docs/systems/gold.md`
`docs/systems/cut-items.md`
`game/gamemode.js`
`game/data/recipes.json`

## Steps

- [ ] Condition runs from 0% to 120%. The three kits and who may make them are on the durability page. The half that makes the kit repairs to 120%. Anyone else repairs to 100%.
- [ ] At 0%, a worn piece has the break chance on that page. A piece sitting in a chest does not roll that chance.
- [ ] A crafted good or a shop good in a shop chest or a house container loses 5% of its condition per real day. A pack does not dull. Worn gear does not dull this way. Opening the chest does not reset the day.
- [ ] Tempering is not repair. The grindstone and armour-table rows stay in the cut list so an event can bring one back. They are not how a piece is fixed. Mastercraft is the 120% repair, not a second temper system.

## Done when

A kit repairs to the number for who used it, a stocked chest dulls, and a temper is not counted as work.

## Traps

Glass, ebony, and stalhrim use the same kits as iron. Do not delete the temper references from the cut file. The recipe book still lists them until the cut work removes them from the open menu.

Order: 821

title: Wire the filled skill perks
body:
## What is wrong or wanted

The fifteen sub-skills, the cap of 5, the per-point numbers, the placed points, and the free point per rank are in the server. Cheat Death, Troll's Blood, and the other filled perks are named. The ones that are a once-a-day effect are not all wired. Precision's critical chance is recorded and the game may ignore it.

## Where it lives

`docs/systems/skill-tree.md`
`game/gamemode.js`

## Steps

- [ ] Each filled perk on the skill tree page does the magnitude written there, including the once-a-day clocks.
- [ ] When a perk actually fires, record that on the page's later pass the page asks for.
- [ ] Precision: if the game ignores the critical chance, say so in the server answer. Do not pretend the hit was a crit.

## Done when

Spending the point changes the fight or the day the way the page says, and a once-a-day perk does not fire twice.

## Traps

The per-point numbers are already in the server. Do not replace them with a second set. Warrior maneuvers are the warrior page, not these perks.

The book, the points, the tomes, and the three gates are in the server. `collegeSemester` is 2 and `outsiderSemester` is 1, and neither is applied. There is no `/study` and no test that you are in the College. Mod spell menus are not stripped. Dead Thrall is not refused when the target is a person. Order: 824

title: Add commands to take an apprentice and to end it
body:
## What is wrong or wanted

Picking a profession writes the sister half at novice. The craft gate allows that novice list and a taught half at novice, and it refuses both above novice by name. `teach` is in the rules and nothing calls it. There is no command to take someone on, and no command to end it. When work is counted, the master is not passed in, so a sister half's count waits at the next threshold and never rises.

## Where it lives

`docs/systems/apprenticeship.md`
`docs/systems/professions.md`
`game/gamemode.js`

## Steps

- [ ] A master can take someone on and can end it. Nobody is owed one.
- [ ] The sister half past novice needs a master of that half and does not use one of the two outside trades.
- [ ] An outside trade is a novice list, twice in a life, and it never climbs.
- [ ] Work done while taught counts for the learner the way the page says, and the sister half can rise past the stuck threshold.

## Done when

The commands exist, ending it closes the taught list, and a sister half's count moves when the work is real.

## Traps

Smelting and tanning are not the two outside trades. Do not let a taught novice make the expert list.

Order: 825

title: Make the enchanter and the lab follow their lists
body:
## What is wrong or wanted

The benches are closed to the right halves. The menus still teach, enchant, and brew whatever Skyrim would. The server does not read the enchantment or the effect, so it cannot refuse one that is off the list. Twin Souls is not a second slot. Learned enchantments are not kept past the staff spells. A batch is not a piece of work. The double batch is not applied.

## Where it lives

`docs/systems/enchantments.md`
`docs/systems/mixtures.md`
`docs/systems/professions/enchanter.md`
`docs/systems/professions/alchemist.md`
`game/gamemode.js`

- [ ] Keep the learned-enchantment list the enchanter page asks for.

An off-list enchantment or effect is refused, a batch counts as work, and Twin Souls can hold the second effect the page allows.

## Traps

The bench gates are already in the server. Do not open the lab or the enchanter to every profession. Heart stone's rank is the miner work.

Order: 826

title: Spawn the Thalmor remnant and reserve the embassy
body:
## What is wrong or wanted

The Accord is on the site. The embassy building can be claimed like any other door. Nothing reserves it, caps the roll at 20, or counts the 6 who may be armed. Imperial gear is still in the crafting lists and still in the world. No remnant roll exists. No Thalmor patrol is spawned. No marker on a character reads Thalmor. The robes are not race locked, and the world can still hand them out.

## Where it lives

`docs/systems/thalmor.md`
`docs/systems/embassy.md`
`docs/systems/npcs.md`
`docs/systems/cut-items.md`
`game/gamemode.js`

## Steps

- [ ] Reserve the embassy building for the office. The roll is 20, of whom 6 may be armed, inside the walls only. The 21st person is refused. The 7th armed person is refused.
- [ ] It is not a hold. Solitude's box and board stay Solitude's. The Haafingar steward cannot evict it.

The building enforces 20 and 6, a patrol can exist inside the cap, and a public forge will not make those suits.

## Traps

The Ambassador and the Archmage are titles, not commands to invent. Guards of a hold are the hold's. There is no crime gold. Do not spawn a court, a bandit camp, or a priest as part of this.

Order: 827

title: Take the cut rows out of the open craft book
body:
## What is wrong or wanted

`docs/systems/cut-items.md` names what leaves the open book: 3318 cut references, 15 embassy, and 9 thalmor. Nothing in `game/data/recipes.json` has been removed by that page. The same rows are in `docs/systems/cut-items.json`. Bladebinder still says nothing has been removed from the recipe file. Temper rows are in the cut file and still appear as menu lines.

`docs/systems/cut-items.md`
`docs/systems/cut-items.json`
`game/data/recipes.json`
`scripts/dev/Write-SystemLists.js`

Order: 828

title: Let a holder set the night's price and make rest find a bed
body:
## What is wrong or wanted

`/rest bed` believes the word. It does not look for a bed. A holder cannot set a price for a night. `/bed` does not exist. Once a night is paid, the plan's rest rates differ for an inn and for an owned, rented, or allowed bed.

## Where it lives

`docs/systems/property.md`
`docs/systems/exhaustion.md`
`game/gamemode.js`

## Steps

- [ ] `/bed 20` at the building sets the gold for one night. `/bed -` is free for someone the holder has allowed. `/bed` with no amount says the price. The gold is handed to the holder.
- [ ] An inn is the same rule. The holder sets the night. There is no server inn price.
- [ ] `/rest bed` counts only when the person is at a real bed they are allowed to use.
- [ ] After the night is paid, use the rest rates on the property page.

## Done when

Saying the word in the street does not count as a bed, and the holder receives the gold they set.

## Traps

Outhouses and pots are the optional body meter. Do not add them here. The fire in the hearth is already a fire. A claim does not add container slots.

Order: 829

title: Build the trading company haul and the sale cuts
body:
## What is wrong or wanted

The company is not built. The box exists, and jobs exist, and the server does not pay the taker of an ordinary job. There is no `/haul`, no tenth, and no withdrawal from the ledger. There is no application, no event that deletes an item, and no gold destroyed for a sale. The ledger only goes up.

## Where it lives

`docs/systems/trading-company.md`
`docs/systems/gold.md`
`docs/systems/property.md`
`game/gamemode.js`

## Steps

- [ ] Add the application and `/haul` the trading company page describes. The company keeps a tenth, rounded down. Pay under 10 gold keeps nothing.
- [ ] The haul pay is withdrawn from the hold ledger. The ledger must be able to go down.
- [ ] A company event sale: the worker takes 10%, another 10% is destroyed, and the seller receives the rest. Under 10 gold, neither cut is taken. The item leaves the world.

## Done when

A haul pays from the ledger with the tenth kept, and a sale under 10 gold pays the whole price with nothing destroyed.

## Traps

An ordinary job on the notice board is not a haul. Scene gold is created and is not a ledger withdrawal. An item has no gold price of its own. The sale price is the price the people agreed.

Order: 830

title: Charge carriage and ferry fares onto the hold ledger
body:
## What is wrong or wanted

Fast travel is off. The carriage and ferry mod is in the collection, and the ride is its fade. The server does not take a fare, does not keep a route list, and does not refuse the ride when the pack is short.

## Where it lives

`docs/systems/carriages.md`
`docs/systems/gold.md`
`game/gamemode.js`

## Steps

- [ ] Keep the route list and the fares on the carriages page. Raven Rock is the dearer fare that page names.
- [ ] Take the fare onto the departure hold's ledger before the ride. Refuse the ride when the pack is short.
- [ ] The driver's conversation has to ask the server. The mod's own talk does not know the ledger.

## Done when

A short pack cannot ride, and the fare is on that hold's ledger afterwards.

## Traps

Fast travel stays off. The fare is not created and it is not the driver's personal purse. Solitude's carriage is Solitude's, including a ride that starts at the embassy.

Order: 831

title: Make speech local and draw lines above a head
body:
## What is wrong or wanted

`/ooc` is local. Plain speech is not, because the local switch ships off, so a plain line goes to everybody who has the game open. `/me`, `/do`, `/w`, and `/s` are only caught while that switch is on. Nothing floats above a head. An emote's name is not drawn above a head. Chop wood on the wheel is not a chop.

## Where it lives

`docs/systems/chat.md`
`docs/systems/emotes.md`
`docs/systems/people.md`
`game/gamemode.js`

## Steps

- [ ] Turn local speech on. Plain speech uses the range on the chat page. Whisper, ordinary speech, and a yell use that page's distances and colors.
- [ ] `/me`, `/do`, `/w`, and `/s` are caught as commands.
- [ ] A line above the head lasts 6 seconds and cuts at 80 characters. It uses the ordinary range. It does not follow the worldwide box.
- [ ] The emote name is drawn above the head. Chop wood on the wheel does not count as a woodcutter's chop.

## Done when

Two people in another hold do not hear a plain line, and the speaker's words and emote name show above the head for the written time.

## Traps

`/ooc` stays 4000 units in the same cell. Do not make the overhead line worldwide. Voice range is the voice work.

Order: 832

title: Draw the voice mark and add text mute, hidden names, and silence
body:
## What is wrong or wanted

The three distances, V, O, B, and the voice mute are in the server. The voice mute is only the level on your machine. It does not touch text. The mark above the head is not in the world. The launcher's speaking light is not above a head and is not colored by distance. Text mute, hiding a name, hiding every name, and saving those are not in the server. `/silence` is not a command.

## Where it lives

`docs/systems/voice.md`
`docs/systems/people.md`

## Steps

- [ ] Draw the mark above the head, colored by the distance on the voice page.
- [ ] Text mute, hide one name, hide every name, and save those, as the page says.
- [ ] `/silence` is the staff command on that page. `/mute` stays voice unless the page says it also covers text.

## Done when

A listener sees who is speaking and at which distance, a text mute survives a restart if the page says it is saved, and staff can silence.

## Traps

The microphone stays the launcher's. Do not send the voice audio through a new server mixer unless the page asks for that. Party markers are already in the server.

Order: 833

title: Thin the placed cast down to the plan
body:
## What is wrong or wanted

Traders and drivers are in the world as the game placed them. The known-issues page says those two groups stay and the rest is thinned, and that thinning is not done. No actor is remade yet. The hosting limit is the engine's and it stays.

## Where it lives

`docs/systems/npcs.md`
`docs/systems/thalmor.md`

## Steps

- [ ] Take out or remake the actors the page says do not stay: bandit camps, wandering dogs, the jarl's court as the game wrote it, priests who are not a person, and the other fillers placed so the province would look full.
- [ ] Traders and carriage and ferry drivers stay.
- [ ] Do not add crime gold, a stolen tag, or a bounty number. Theft stays the rule on the site.

## Done when

The live cast is the one the page lists, and a filler actor is not still simulating a town.

## Traps

Thalmor patrols are the remnant work, not a reason to keep the old justiciars. The embassy roll is people, not actors. Guards, when a hold remakes them, are that hold's. Do not build a purse here. The trader purse is the guild work. Animals, fish, seams, plants, and crops are the classes.

Order: 834

title: Apply fuel grades and the master bonuses that are still names
body:
## What is wrong or wanted

The forge still burns the cheapest charcoal in the pack and does not read the grade table on the smith page. A drum, a flute, and a lute are asked for a tool handle. The hotter kiln is not applied. Master Weaver is not wired into warmth or armour. Master Carver's fire is not applied. Grand Chef's second portion is not. The wheel and temper rows are not scored, which the durability work replaces rather than scoring.

## Where it lives

`docs/systems/professions/smith.md`
`docs/systems/professions/woodworker.md`
`docs/systems/professions/woodworker/charburner.md`
`docs/systems/professions/woodworker/woodwright.md`
`docs/systems/professions/tailor.md`
`docs/systems/professions/cook.md`
`docs/systems/temperature.md`
`game/gamemode.js`

## Steps

- [ ] The forge reads the grade table on the smith page instead of always burning Poor Charcoal first.
- [ ] A drum, a flute, and a lute are not asked for a tool handle. A war axe, a battleaxe, a warhammer, and a mace still take one.
- [ ] The hotter kiln, Master Weaver's warmth and hidden armour, Master Carver's fire, and Grand Chef's second portion do what their pages say.
- [ ] Leave temper rows unscored. Repair is the kit.

## Done when

A pack of better charcoal is the grade the table names, a lute can be made without a handle, and each of those master bonuses changes the result.

## Traps

The recipe ingredient column omits the handle because the plugin record does. The server check is what must stay right. Do not turn Mastercraft into a temper bonus on top of the kit.

Order: 835

title: Give the party leader kick, lead, and disband
body:
## What is wrong or wanted

The offer, the accept, the leave, the cap of 6, the 15%, and the same-cell test are in the server. The leader is stored. If the leader leaves, the lead already passes, and a party of one already ends. Kick, handing the lead across, and disband are not commands. Anyone in the party can already invite. P offers Leave to everyone, including the leader.

## Where it lives

`docs/systems/party.md`
`game/gamemode.js`

## Steps

- [ ] The leader can kick, hand the lead to someone else in the party, and disband.
- [ ] P shows those to the leader, and Leave stays available.
- [ ] Keep the cap of 6, the same-cell bonus, and the rule that a party of one ends.

## Done when

A leader can remove someone, name the next leader, or end the party, and nobody else can.

## Traps

The green name, the map marker, and the strip are already in the server. The bonus is a whole extra piece, not a fraction on the screen. Do not let every member kick.

Order: 836

title: Gate smelting to the smith and tanning to the Platewright
body:
## What is wrong or wanted

Smelting an ingot belongs to the smith halves. Tanning a hide into leather belongs to the Platewright. One row of each stays. The server still leaves smelting and tanning open to anybody.

## Where it lives

`docs/systems/professions.md`
`docs/systems/cut-items.md`
`game/gamemode.js`

## Steps

- [ ] Refuse a smelt unless the person can work a smith half at the rank that row asks.
- [ ] Refuse a hide into leather unless the person can work Platewright at the rank that row asks.
- [ ] Duplicate ingot rows stay cut. They are not a second public recipe.

## Done when

Someone with no smith half cannot smelt, and someone who is not a Platewright cannot tan the leather row.

## Traps

The tanning rack can stay open furniture. The recipe is what refuses. The forge is the same shape. Do not close the rack to the point that a Platewright cannot use it. Nails, hinges, locks, and iron fittings stay refused.

Order: 837

title: Stop vanilla perk lines from hiding recipes the server allows
body:
## What is wrong or wanted

The server gates recipes by profession, rank, and race. The crafting menu still hides some of those recipes behind Skyrim's own perk lines, so a person the server would allow never sees the row. The cook's menu still shows those vanilla perk lines. The same gap is named on the professions page.

## Where it lives

`docs/systems/professions.md`
`docs/systems/professions/cook/confectioner.md`
`game/gamemode.js`

## Steps

- [ ] A recipe the server would allow is visible in the menu without the vanilla perk.
- [ ] A recipe the server would refuse stays hidden or fails at the server, with the reason the craft gate already gives.
- [ ] Check the cook menus and the other benches the professions page names.

## Done when

A novice who may make the row can see it and make it, and a person who may not is still refused.

## Traps

Race locks that already reach the server stay enforced. Do not open a cut row by clearing a perk line. The cut work is what removes those.

Order: 838
